\caption{The four policies around one compaction, with time running down; numbers of steps are illustrative. When the context crosses the threshold, S and K wait while the summary is written, A keeps working, and L does not compact until its 1M-token limit. The first request after the switch then sees the summary alone (S), the summary followed by the steps taken meanwhile (A) or by the two steps before the threshold (K), or, for L, the whole history. The labels on the left mark where each research question is measured: the wait, in paired API runs and on one GPU (Section~\ref{sec:wait}); the next actions, in full runs and same-state branches (Section~\ref{sec:behavior}); and the repayment, in money at API cache prices and in time on one GPU (Section~\ref{sec:cost}).}
\label{fig:overview}
\end{figure*}
